title: JobPollOptions
description: How a job's `pollUntilComplete` asks for the job's status: how long it waits between its asks, and how long it goes on asking. A member left out is client/timing.json's: `jobPollMs` and `jobPollTimeoutMs`.

everyMs.description: How long it waits between one ask and the next, in milliseconds.

withinMs.description: How long it goes on asking, from its first ask, before it fails as timed out, in milliseconds.
